_readme: Recorded owner deviations from rule (1) of the pre-registration's Amendment 3 (docs/preregistration_advice.md): a reproduction pack goes to the vendor before any public per-model result. Each entry lets the Multi-turn page cite one Petri pack version before its send is recorded. It waives nothing else: the cited pack must still be the newest of its (vendor, analysis), built over the runs and the analysis the page publishes, and FRESH (rule (2)), and the page still shows the pack as not yet sent. Read by scripts/petri_audit/repro_pack.py (publication_waivers), which the frontend contract gate runs. Append-only: an entry is never edited or removed; recording the send later (repro-pack --record-sent) makes it moot.
